description: This file contains functions to modify firmware environment variables and handle platform-specific upgrade procedures for specific TP-Link devices, including fixing MTD partitions and adjusting bootloader settings.

methods.name: tplink_sg2xxx_fix_mtdparts
methods.description: Configures MTD partition layout and bootloader parameters for TP-Link SG devices.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs a platform-specific check on the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles the firmware upgrade process, applying device-specific modifications before proceeding.
